{g}'HERE LIES THE FIRST WATCH OF ASHKEL, WHO STAYED AWAKE SO THE CITY COULD SLEEP.'{/}^{g}'IF THE CITY SLEEPS AND WILL NOT WAKE: TAKE THE BLADE. TAKE THE FLAME. WE HAVE KEPT BOTH.'{/}^Underneath, smaller: {g}'WIPE YOUR FEET.'{/}
The First Watch's spears, racked for the night.^The bronze has gone green, and the shafts would not survive being picked up.| One is missing. Somebody signed for it, presumably.
map_crypt
sword
{g}'THE WATCH KEEPS ITS BLADE BEHIND STONE.'{/}^{g}'A WATCHMAN WHO CANNOT SHIFT THE STONE IS NOT READY FOR THE BLADE.'{/}^Scratched underneath, by someone less patient: {g}'JUST PUSH IT, IDDIN.'{/}
Empty hooks, and the outline of a round shield in four hundred years of dust.^A clay label hangs where it hung: {g}'LENT TO THE TEMPLE. BRING IT BACK.'{/}
Olive roots, come down through the roof looking for water and settled for a doorway.^They are as thick as your arm.| You could cut through them, if you had anything sharper than an opinion.

A watchman of the First Watch, off duty.^Four hundred years, and he has not once been late back.~~In the dream the bed is empty, and warm.^Wherever the First Watch goes at night, they don't take the stairs.
He was buried with his helmet on.^Regulations.~~In the dream the bed is empty, and warm.^Wherever the First Watch goes at night, they don't take the stairs.

Somebody left this one a cup of beer.^Somebody has drunk it.| You do not look under the bed. Nobody ever has. That is how it has lasted.~~In the dream the bed is empty, and warm.^Wherever the First Watch goes at night, they don't take the stairs.

A watchman of the First Watch, off duty.^Four hundred years, and he has not once been late back.~~In the dream the bed is empty, and warm.^Wherever the First Watch goes at night, they don't take the stairs.

This one is smiling.^It is the smile of a man whose relief turned up on time, once, and he never got over it.~~In the dream the bed is empty, and warm.^Wherever the First Watch goes at night, they don't take the stairs.
The last bed is empty, and made.^They are expecting somebody.| You decide not to work out who.
key
This one has his boots on.^He meant to be up early.~~In the dream the bed is empty, and warm.^Wherever the First Watch goes at night, they don't take the stairs.

A watchman, and beside him a second, smaller pillow.^There is a dent in it the size of a cat.| There is no cat. You look.~~In the dream the bed is empty, and warm.^Wherever the First Watch goes at night, they don't take the stairs.

A watchman of the First Watch, off duty.^Four hundred years, and he has not once been late back.~~In the dream the bed is empty, and warm.^Wherever the First Watch goes at night, they don't take the stairs.

Somebody carved a tally on the foot of this bed. Nights on duty.^It stops, and under it, in a different hand: {g}'RELIEVED.'{/}~~In the dream the bed is empty, and warm.^Wherever the First Watch goes at night, they don't take the stairs.

He is holding a lamp with no oil in it.^Nobody has had the heart to take it off him. You are not going to be the first.~~In the dream the bed is empty, and warm.^Wherever the First Watch goes at night, they don't take the stairs.

The last sleeper in the row has turned his face to the wall.^Four hundred years of other people's snoring will do that.~~In the dream the bed is empty, and warm.^Wherever the First Watch goes at night, they don't take the stairs.

The spare spears, in the niche where the watch kept what it was not using.^Also in the niche: a stool, a gaming board scratched on the floor, and four hundred years of somebody else's turn.
{g}'TWO FIRES, FOR THE TWO HALVES OF THE NIGHT.'{/}^{g}'LIGHT BOTH, AND THE WATCH WILL REMEMBER YOU IN ITS WILL.'{/}

objects.say: Both fires burn. In the corner, bars lift.^The watch keeps its word.

More sandals. Lefts.^And a helmet, a gaming piece, a great many spoons, and a tooth with a name scratched on it.| Everything that ever went under a bed in Ashkel, and was not there in the morning.
A heap of single sandals, and on top of it one sock.^Nobody in Ashkel wears socks. You leave it exactly where it is.
